clips.title: The story
paras: At the edge of the Barrens and Ashenvale, Kadrak gives the Horde a mark to carry into enemy ground. The flag is planted in the Talon Den after Keymaster Rynthariel is killed.

Kadrak sends the Horde flag into the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak. The dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Den, has sent communications across the border, and Kadrak decides her death alone will not answer them. He gives you the crimson banner to plant deep inside the Den. The Horde colors there carry a warning to the night elves and dryads: incursions across the Barrens will meet retaliation on Alliance soil.
